short: Mapping imagined onto listened MEG (M06) is ahead in design, but the subject-calibrated CNN gain is unproven: no ablation, a channel-shuffling null, and r 0.0113 against 0.0063.
position: The paper changes M06 (ahead: no earlier imagined-to-listened neural mapping among 112 ledger studies, pattern match), M03 (standard: subject-layer recipe refitted on the held-out subject) and M11 (standard). Its claim that the calibrated CNN generalizes where linear mappings fail lacks controls; the null shuffles channels, and the authors' own later study finds a linear mapping transfers without calibration.
